meta.access_policy: ATTENTION: AGENTS MUST ONLY READ OR OPERATE THIS TEMPLATE THROUGH THE xc-orchestration-author SKILL AND ITS PUBLIC COMMANDS. DO NOT OPEN, SUMMARIZE, EDIT, PATCH, OR REFORMAT THIS FILE DIRECTLY.

node.title: Open decision session record
node.instructions: Create clarification.session_artifact as a validated xc-document node-artifact. Record the mode, subject, declared inputs, and initial decision budget. Do not read or edit runtime XML.
node.deliverables: One decision-session.md node artifact at clarification.session_artifact.
node.acceptance: The session artifact exists, validates as node-artifact, and records the clarification scope without storing dynamic control state.

node.title: Gather decision evidence
node.instructions: Inspect only the supplied inputs and project bridge references. Append confirmed facts, source locations, contradictions, and evidence gaps to clarification.session_artifact. Resolve factual questions without asking the user.
node.deliverables: Evidence appended to the decision session artifact.
node.acceptance: The artifact distinguishes confirmed facts, hypotheses, and unknowns with traceable evidence.

node.title: Map material decisions
node.instructions: Append a dependency-ordered decision map to clarification.session_artifact. Classify each uncertainty as evidence-resolved, human-decision, bounded-experiment, or accepted-assumption, and identify material human decisions.
node.deliverables: A decision map in the session artifact.
node.acceptance: Every material human decision has an ID, dependencies, evidence, and a proposed next question.

node.title: Seed decision questioning
node.instructions: Read the decision map from clarification.session_artifact. Before completing this task, use xc-orchestration-runtime to add the first main-executor decision Gate beneath question-group. If no material decision exists, add a closing confirmation Gate instead. Do not leave question-group empty.
node.deliverables: A first decision Gate or a closing confirmation Gate in question-group.
node.acceptance: The next runtime query exposes an executable main Gate and question-group cannot block as an empty composite.

node.title: Synthesize clarified decisions
node.instructions: After question-group closes, append the final decision summary, bounded experiments, accepted risks, residual risks, and caller handoff readiness to clarification.session_artifact.
node.acceptance: The artifact states whether the caller may select a solution without hidden material decisions.

node.title: Finalize clarification
node.instructions: Confirm clarification.status and clarification.outcome from the accepted session artifact. Record the artifact path and concise handoff result through the runtime public interface.
node.deliverables: A completed, deferred, or blocked clarification disposition.
node.acceptance: The caller can safely continue to analysis synthesis or solution selection without reading runtime XML.
